name: autotrader_uk-mcp
description: Autotrader UK (automotive): search_listings, get_listing, decode_vin, get_valuation. Every tool maps

platform_mcp_autotrader_uk_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTOTRADER_UK_KEY
platform_mcp_autotrader_uk_key.description: Autotrader Connect API key (issued after Autotrader qualifies your integration; production and sandbox keys differ); POSTed form-encoded to https://api.autotrader.co.uk/authenticate.

platform_mcp_autotrader_uk_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTOTRADER_UK_SECRET
platform_mcp_autotrader_uk_secret.description: The matching API secret. Access tokens last 15 minutes and are re-minted on expiry or 401; unused credentials are removed after 90 days.

platform_mcp_autotrader_uk_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTOTRADER_UK_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_autotrader_uk_advertiser_id.description: Autotrader advertiser id your credentials are permitted for (sent as advertiserId on every call, as in all documented examples).

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: GET /search (Capability: Search) — filters the stock of your permitted advertisers (advertiserId from config); make/model are Autotrader standard names (standardMake=Ford, standardModel=Focus), location a UK postcode (distance not mapped), prices in GBP, mileage in miles, condition New|Used. pageSize ≤ 200 per the docs. yearOfManufacture (a string), derivative, media and responseMetrics stay in raw.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /search?searchId=<advert searchId>&advertiserId: the documented way to fetch one advert (listing_id = metadata.searchId from search_listings).

tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: GET /vehicles?vin=&advertiserId (Capability: Vehicle Taxonomy). 'VIN look ups are supported for a selection of OEMs only'; UK registrations (VRM) use ?registration=, which the vocabulary has no input for. engine is the derivative description; yearOfManufacture (string), generation and the technical data stay in raw.

tools.name: get_valuation
tools.description: GET /vehicles?vin&valuations=true&odometerReadingMiles (Capability: Current Valuations; mileage in miles is required). low = trade, mid = private, high = retail valuation (GBP); partExchange is in raw. VIN lookups cover selected OEMs only.
